description: Discover the updates integrated into the GGE Assistant tactical system.

_content: 🔹 **/player**: Improvement to the `player` command: Added statistics for loot, maximum loot, maximum honor, dove, maximum might, and castle names for main and secondary kingdoms.
🔹 **/woa history**: Fixed a minor bug where the total tickets spent, displayed during `/woa history`, were not shown correctly.

🔹 **/event_player storm_islands history**: Fixed a major bug in the `event_joueur history` command that was not displaying the correct player results for previous events. Improved the command's visual presentation by adding a drop-down menu.

content: 🔹 **Language and server**: Support for servers WORLD 2, INT3, US1, and GB1, in addition to EK4_FR1. Support for English and German languages. You can launch the configuration via /setup.
🔹 **Translation**: Translation of all commands, their arguments, and descriptions from French to English.
🔹 **Scan**: Redesign of the server scanning system based on user needs.
🔹 **Fortress**: Improved the /fortress command: added a button to restart the scan and a button to check if fortresses are still attackable; removed the button for copying coordinates.
🔹 **Removal**: Removal of the /set_objectif and /event_summary commands, as they were rarely used.
🔹 **/fortress history**: Added the `/fortress history` command, which returns the history of fortresses captured by a player.
🔹 **Storm Islands**: /event_joueur: Added support for Storm Islands history and the /leaderboard storm_islands command.

🔹 **Implementation of the /calendar command group**: Allows setting a channel where alerts about the start and end of events will be sent, as well as the results for one or more automatically selected alliances.
🔹 **/calendar setup command**: Allows setting the channel where alerts will be sent.
🔹 **/calendar track command**: Allows adding an alliance to track its event results.
🔹 **/calendar untrack command**: Allows removing an alliance from event tracking.
🔹 **/calendar current command**: Displays the event calendar for the current month.
🔹 **Graphical Overhaul**: Replaced many basic emojis with GGE-related emojis.
🔹 **/history command**: Removed the history type selection, graphical update with one button per history type.
🔹 **Footers**: Harmonized footers across all commands.
🔹 **/target command**: Fixed an issue where /target would suggest players from the attacker's own alliance.
🔹 **/hr command**: Overhauled the command into three tiers: Attack allowed, Warning, and Out of Rules.
🔹 **Bugs and optimizations**: Resolved several bugs and made optimizations allowing for faster and more secure responses.

🔹 **WoA Commands**: Added three commands related to the Wheel of Abundance: /woa history (returns a player's ticket history per month), /woa leaderboard (returns the results of the current WoA), /woa summary (server WoA statistics).
🔹 **/help command**: Graphical and organizational overhaul of /help. Now works by chapter.
🔹 **/changelog command**: Graphical overhaul of /changelog: One page per changelog, from newest to oldest.
🔹 **Comparison Command**: Re-introduced the /compare_player command. The /compare_alliance command remains unavailable.
🔹 **Embed Colors**: Modified embed colors. There is now a specific shade for each type of command.
🔹 **/alliance command**: Fixed an issue preventing information retrieval. Overhauled the way the API is queried.
🔹 **/target command**: Reduced suggested targets from 25 to 10. Added a button to relaunch targets (with the initial command parameters) in one click.
🔹 **Comparison Command**: Both comparison commands have been temporarily removed for maintenance.
🔹 **/fortress scan Overhaul**: Replaced the pop-up form with native and fluid arguments.
🔹 **Smart Input**: Integrated real-time autocomplete for the target player's username.
🔹 **Realm Order**: Logical organization (Ice ❄️ ➔ Sands 🏜️ ➔ Peaks 🌋) and disabled by default (`False`).
🔹 **Mobile Optimization**: Limited to 10 targets max and added individual copy buttons generating ephemeral blocks (Click-to-Copy).
🔹 **Load Regulation**: Distance fixed to the maximum (999 leagues) and dynamic calculation of frequency (5-20 min) and duration based on overall usage.
🔹 **Cascading Search**: 3-tier anticipation algorithm (Immediate ➔ <5 min ➔ <1h ➔ Invitation to grab a coffee ☕).
🔹 **Alliance Radar**: Added a limit of 3 simultaneously tracked alliances per Discord user.
🔹 **Player Radar**: Added a limit of 25 simultaneously tracked players per Discord user.
🔹 **Rival Radar (League)**: Automatic closure of the radar after 4 days.
🔹 **System Diagnostic**: Added the `/status` command to monitor storage and the API.
🔹 **Help and Suggestions**: Added the `/contact` command to send a message to the GGE Assistant developers.
